title: Investment House LLC Trims Stake in Apple Inc. (AAPL)

organizations.name: investment house llc trims stake in apple inc.

text:
Investment House LLC reduced its position in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 1.1% in the 2nd quarter, according to its most recent Form 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The firm owned 266,609 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 2,934 shares during the period. Apple comprises about 5.7% of Investment House LLC’s investment portfolio, making the stock its largest holding. Investment House LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $49,352,000 at the end of the most recent reporting period.
Other hedge funds have also recently bought and sold shares of the company. First PREMIER Bank boosted its position in Apple by 7.4% during the second quarter. First PREMIER Bank now owns 22,100 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $4,090,000 after purchasing an additional 1,517 shares during the last quarter. State of Alaska Department of Revenue boosted its position in Apple by 21.3% during the second quarter. State of Alaska Department of Revenue now owns 705,184 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $130,536,000 after purchasing an additional 124,042 shares during the last quarter. Pure Financial Advisors Inc. boosted its position in Apple by 5.0% during the second quarter. Pure Financial Advisors Inc. now owns 21,397 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $3,961,000 after purchasing an additional 1,018 shares during the last quarter. Cobiz Wealth LLC boosted its position in Apple by 0.9% during the second quarter. Cobiz Wealth LLC now owns 92,786 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $17,176,000 after purchasing an additional 873 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Private Capital Advisors Inc. boosted its position in Apple by 1.1% during the second quarter. Private Capital Advisors Inc. now owns 75,393 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $13,956,000 after purchasing an additional 830 shares during the last quarter. 58.54% of the stock is owned by institutional investors.
